summary: A leaked Geekbench listing suggests the Google Pixel 10 Pro's GPU score is significantly lower than its predecessor, the Pixel 9 Pro, and far behind rival flagships. While single and multi-core performance are shown to be improved over the Pixel 9 Pro XL, the low GPU score indicates the Pixel 10 series may struggle with demanding games. Google anticipates faster everyday use and better AI performance, which might satisfy non-gamers. However, mobile gamers are advised to reconsider the Pixel 10 models due to the shared Tensor G5 chipset. The result is based on a single leak and could be an outlier or subject to future software optimization.
pros: Improved single-core performance compared to Pixel 9 Pro XL
Improved multi-core performance compared to Pixel 9 Pro XL
Expected to feel faster in everyday use
Expected to perform better for AI tasks
Potential for GPU performance to improve via software updates
cons: Significantly lower GPU score than the Pixel 9 Pro
GPU score drastically behind rival phones (Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus, iPhone 16 Pro)
All Pixel 10 models (using Tensor G5) are likely to have similar GPU performance issues
